name: 13617 · Canton, NY
findings: ZIP 13617 (Canton) has 74 nonprofit organizations. 40 of them (54%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 34 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (22% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 13617 (Canton) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 13617 (Canton) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 22 organizations here; 22% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to volunteer so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
